transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02 (PR #2431, specs/external-floor FR16). It was replaced by the rewritten standalone Floor engine, re-cinq/floor. That engine runs in the same cluster as Lore, and Lore reaches it only through @re-cinq/floor-client (ADR-049). The lines moved across one family at a time. The code-review family now runs there as floor pipeline files under libs/assembly-lines/src/floor-pipelines/. The deletion removed about 17,500 lines and 113 test files, the Helm subchart, five ticks only the old floor answered, and its bus subscription.
